tasks.title: Configure Testing Infrastructure (Jest + React Testing Library + Playwright)
tasks.description: Set up comprehensive testing environment with Jest for unit/integration tests and Playwright for E2E testing, following TDD workflow requirements
tasks.details:
Install and configure testing frameworks:

1. Install dependencies:
   - jest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, jest-environment-jsdom
   - @playwright/test for E2E testing
   - ts-jest for TypeScript support

2. Create jest.config.js with Next.js compatibility:
   - Set up module name mapper for @/ alias
   - Configure testEnvironment: 'jsdom'
   - Set coverage thresholds (80% overall, 90% for business logic)

3. Create playwright.config.ts:
   - Configure browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari)
   - Set up device emulation (Desktop 1920x1080, Tablet 768x1024, Mobile 375x667)
   - Configure base URL and timeout settings

4. Set up test directory structure:
   - __tests__/ for unit tests
   - e2e/ for Playwright tests
   - test-utils.tsx for shared testing utilities

5. Add test scripts to package.json:
   - test: 'jest --watch'
   - test:ci: 'jest --ci'
   - test:coverage: 'jest --coverage'
   - test:e2e: 'playwright test'

6. Create example test to validate setup
tasks.testStrategy: Verify installation with simple component test and E2E test. Ensure jest --version and playwright --version work. Run test suite to confirm 0 tests passing initially.

tasks.title: Set Up CI/CD Pipeline with GitHub Actions
tasks.description: Configure automated testing, linting, and build workflows in GitHub Actions
tasks.details:
Create .github/workflows/ directory with three workflow files:

1. test.yml - Automated Testing Workflow:
   - Trigger on push to main/develop and all PRs
   - Run lint, typecheck, unit tests with coverage report
   - Upload coverage to artifacts
   - Fail if coverage < 80%

2. e2e.yml - E2E Testing Workflow:
   - Trigger on push to main and PRs
   - Install Playwright browsers
   - Run E2E test suite on Chrome, Firefox, Safari
   - Upload test results and screenshots on failure

3. build.yml - Production Build Workflow:
   - Trigger on push to main
   - Run next build
   - Verify build succeeds without errors
   - Check bundle size (initial < 200KB)

Ensure all workflows use Node.js 20.x and Yarn 4.5.0 for consistency with package.json.
tasks.testStrategy: Create dummy failing test, push to trigger workflows. Verify workflows execute and report failure. Fix test, verify workflows pass.

subtasks.title: Create test.yml workflow for automated testing
subtasks.description: Set up GitHub Actions workflow for linting, type-checking, and unit tests with coverage reporting
subtasks.details:
Create .github/workflows/test.yml:
- Trigger on push to main/develop and all pull requests
- Use actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-node@v4
- Configure Node.js 20.x with Yarn 4.5.0
- Enable Yarn caching with actions/cache
- Install dependencies with yarn install --immutable
- Run yarn lint (ESLint)
- Run yarn type-check (TypeScript compiler)
- Run yarn test --coverage (Jest with coverage)
- Upload coverage report to artifacts using actions/upload-artifact@v4
- Configure coverage thresholds: fail if overall < 80%
- Add status badge to README

Expected output: Working test.yml that fails on lint/type/test errors and generates coverage reports
subtasks.testStrategy: Create intentional lint error, push to trigger workflow, verify it fails. Fix error, verify workflow passes. Check artifacts contain coverage report. Verify coverage threshold enforcement by temporarily lowering coverage.

subtasks.title: Create e2e.yml workflow for Playwright testing
subtasks.description: Set up GitHub Actions workflow for end-to-end testing across multiple browsers with Playwright
subtasks.details:
Create .github/workflows/e2e.yml:
- Trigger on push to main and all pull requests
- Use actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-node@v4
- Configure Node.js 20.x with Yarn 4.5.0
- Install dependencies with yarn install --immutable
- Install Playwright browsers: npx playwright install --with-deps
- Run E2E tests across Chrome, Firefox, Safari using matrix strategy
- Configure test retries (2 retries on failure)
- Upload test results (HTML report) on failure using actions/upload-artifact@v4
- Upload screenshots on failure for debugging
- Add timeout: 30 minutes for long-running tests

Expected output: Working e2e.yml that runs Playwright tests on multiple browsers and uploads failure artifacts
subtasks.testStrategy: Create intentional E2E test failure, push to trigger workflow. Verify workflow fails and uploads screenshots/HTML report. Fix test, verify workflow passes on all three browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari).

subtasks.title: Create build.yml workflow for production build validation

tasks.title: Performance Optimization and Core Web Vitals
tasks.description: Optimize bundle size, implement code splitting, and achieve Lighthouse performance ≥90
tasks.details:
Implement performance optimizations:

1. Bundle size optimization:
   - Analyze bundle with @next/bundle-analyzer
   - Identify large dependencies
   - Implement dynamic imports for heavy components
   - Remove unused code and dependencies
   - Target: initial bundle < 200KB, total < 500KB

2. Code splitting strategy:
   - Use next/dynamic for below-the-fold components
   - Lazy load project detail components
   - Split by route automatically (Next.js default)
   - Prefetch critical routes

3. Font optimization:
   - Use next/font for automatic font optimization
   - Subset fonts to include only used characters
   - Implement font-display: swap

4. JavaScript optimization:
   - Enable SWC minification (Next.js default)
   - Remove console.logs in production
   - Implement tree shaking

5. CSS optimization:
   - Purge unused Tailwind CSS
   - Inline critical CSS
   - Defer non-critical CSS

6. Core Web Vitals targets:
   - LCP (Largest Contentful Paint): < 2.5s
   - FID (First Input Delay): < 100ms
   - CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift): < 0.1

7. Caching strategy:
   - Configure Cache-Control headers
   - Service worker for offline support (optional)
   - Static asset versioning

8. Implement loading states:
   - Skeleton screens for data fetching
   - Loading indicators
   - Smooth transitions
